title: Product A document-session closure for released MIDI content edits

installed_sdk.rationale: The closure records Product A runtime reachability for a released sequencer slice; it adds no SDK header, target, symbol, or installed authority.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: The released slice's offline command surface is unchanged. This row records the live Product A projection, whose CLI reachability is the generic `pulp control` operation.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: The released slice's offline MCP surface is unchanged. This row records the live Product A projection, whose MCP reachability is the generated control catalog.

live_product_control.rationale: Closes the live_product_control gap carried by released row p0-9-midi-content without rewriting that historical row. Product A now exposes the typed TimelineDocumentSession operation; its apply action admits the existing offline command JSON under the same proposal/editor writer profiles, so MIDI content edits are reachable through the exact session executor. The released row remains frozen at its merge snapshot; this pending row carries the current closure evidence.

needles: the seven layers compose end to end over a live document session
a stale expected_revision is refused live under the offline surface's own code
the broker never selects the trusted authority on a caller's behalf

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: Runtime Product A operations are published by the control registry, not by the design-time agent-capabilities manifest.
